data.narrative:
Amogy is a Series C climate and energy technology company founded by Seonghoon Woo, currently valued at $700M post-money after raising $300M+. The valuation analysis employs a comparable universe of 9 private peers and 1 public company (LNZA) operating in the same sector and stage, including KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, Helion, Redwood Materials, and QuantumScape.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis uses the typical Series C to next-stage multiplier of 1.7x applied to the $700M base valuation, yielding $1.2B. Peer-median analysis references three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables: Electric Hydrogen at $1.0B (Series C), KoBold Metals at $3.0B (Series C), and Redwood Materials at $6.0B (Series D). The median of these three peers is $3.0B, establishing an upper-quartile reference point within the Climate & Energy frontier-tech space.

The triangulated range spans $1.0B (low) to $3.4B (high), with a median implied valuation of $2.1B. This suggests the current $700M valuation sits materially below the median peer baseline. Key uncertainties include the timing and magnitude of revenue inflection for Amogy's core technology, capital intensity of scaling to commercial deployment, and the valuation trajectory of the peer set itself, which exhibits wide dispersion ($1.0B to $6.0B) reflecting heterogeneous technology maturity and commercialization timelines.
